thawed cells were diluted slowly with cold 10X Cell Buffer (DPBS + BSA), adding 1 mL at a time followed by gentle inversion before bringing the final volume up to 15-50 mL.

Recall was computed using gene pairs in the top and bottom 5% of similarity ranks and compared against CORUM and STRING.
